system.description:
HEALING MYRATHI VERDANT

Where others see rot, you see material waiting to become life again.
You may use Preserve Remains using Nature instead of Medicine.
When you achieve a Success or better on Preserve Remains, fungal growth stabilises the corpse without significantly disfiguring it.
Furthermore, whenever your racial Purify successfully Counteracts an affliction, the target gains a +1-status bonus to its next Fortitude saving throw made within the next minute.

Prerequisites Vaelori growth, Restorative Spores, Level 5

Works automatically: Nature offers Preserve Remains to you; the +1 status after a successful Purify is queued by Use (target the creature).
